title: Shell mega menu and account polish
summary: The top menu shows tidy mega menus after the logo, with a More overflow when space is tight. Admins switch Intranet and Admin from the account menu, panels are easier to read, and pages use more of the screen width.

added: Top-level menu sections after the logo open multi-column mega menus that stay fully visible.
When there is not enough room, overflowed sections appear under More.
changed: Home goes straight to the dashboard.
Menu groups are clearer: Work (was Operations), Learning under People, soon HR and Agreements under Support.
Admins open Intranet or Admin panel from the account menu instead of a switch beside the logo.
The logo no longer shows a Staff or Admin panel subtitle for admins.
Account and menu panels use a solid background so the text is easier to read.
Multi-column mega menus are wider so labels such as Clock in and out stay on one line.
Mega menus open centred under the top nav so they stay on screen.
Page content uses 95% of the screen width.
removed: The hamburger Open menu button and the side drawer that copied the old left menu.
accessibility: Keyboard users open and close section mega menus and the account menu with Enter, Space and Escape.

internal_notes: Epic #375. Shipped #376 always-visible menus; #377 Staff/Admin in account menu; #378 opaque panels and 95% content width; #383 Home link and single-row top nav; #385 compact dropdowns then #387 mega menus and Intranet label; #389 wider mega panels; #391 centred under the nav.
